title: Logistics Coordinator
responsibilities: Coordinate outbound shipment scheduling with carriers
Walk the distribution floor to verify load accuracy
Troubleshoot delivery exceptions with drivers on site
Maintain relationships with regional carrier partners
minimumRequirements: Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
1+ years in logistics, operations, or a related field
preferredRequirements: Experience with routing or fleet-management software
Team-sport or military background valued for coordination skills
physicalRequirements: Able to walk distribution floor for extended periods
Able to lift up to 30 lbs occasionally
careerPath: Logistics Coordinator -> Senior Coordinator -> Logistics Manager
